candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `depositsCount++;` so the deposit counter is never incremented on receiving ether.
Replace `depositsCount++;` with `depositsCount--;` so the counter decrements (reverting at zero) instead of incrementing.
Replace `depositsCount++;` with `depositsCount += 2;` so each deposit increments the counter by two.
Remove the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll no longer transfers any funds.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll so any caller can withdraw the contract's balance.
Delete the require(msg.sender == owner) check so the onlyOwner modifier imposes no restriction.
Delete the transfer statement so withdraw(uint256) sends no ether.
Replace the transfer amount with a fixed 1 wei instead of _value.
Remove the require(msg.sender == owner) check so the onlyOwner modifier no longer restricts access.
Replace the low-level call with transfer, which reverts on failure instead of silently returning false, changing observable failure behavior of sendMoney.
Check the boolean result of the low-level call so a failed call reverts the transaction instead of silently succeeding.
Remove the ownership check from the onlyOwner modifier so anyone (including non-owners) can invoke sendMoney and move contract funds.
Replace `depositsCount++` with `depositsCount += 2;` so each deposit increases the counter by two.
Delete the `depositsCount++` statement so the counter is never incremented on deposit.
Replace `depositsCount++` with `depositsCount--;` so the counter decrements instead of increments.
Remove the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll no longer transfers the contract balance to the owner.
Replace the withdrawn amount with depositsCount instead of the contract's full balance.
Drop the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can execute withdrawAll.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners pass the modifier.
Delete the ownership require so the modifier imposes no restriction.
Remove the ownership check so any caller passes the onlyOwner modifier.
Transfer half the requested value instead of the full amount to the caller.
Drop the onlyOwner guard so any address can withdraw arbitrary amounts.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from sendMoney so any caller can send funds.
Delete the low-level call so no ether is transferred out of the contract.
Replace the call with a plain transfer of 0 value so the target receives no funds.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners may execute owner-only functions.
Delete the require statement so the modifier imposes no ownership restriction.
Delete the underscore so the guarded function body never executes.
